title: Probability of negative signs on prescribed coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For a uniformly chosen sign vector in $\{-1,1\}^n$, the probability that every coordinate in $J$ equals $-1$ is $2^{-|J|}$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a set of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
